openspec.rationale: Primary engine. Exact pin per the repo dependency-pin discipline; version matches package.json. Needs Node.js 22.12.0+. See docs/guide/spec-engines.md.

speckit.rationale: Supported backup engine. Exact pin per the repo dependency-pin discipline; adapter verified 2026-11-05 against v1.3.0 (specify init --integration, specs/<NNN-slug>/{spec.md,plan.md,tasks.md}). See docs/guide/spec-engines.md.
speckit.notes: install: uv tool install specify-cli --from git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@v1.3.0; init: specify init --here --force --non-interactive --integration <harness>; artifacts under .specify/ and specs/<slug>/{spec.md,plan.md,tasks.md}

native-kbd.rationale: Compatibility engine for projects that already keep native changes or pin native-kbd; not offered as a default. Pack-owned; version tracks this repo. See docs/guide/spec-engines.md.

customEngines.hint: To plug in another spec engine, implement the five adapter ops (list/progress/mark_done/verify/archive) as <prefix>_* functions in kbd-apply.sh, add its detection shape to backend_detect and the pin value to the specBackend case, then register its metadata here. See docs/guide/spec-engines.md.
